name: 66111 · Kansas City, KS
findings: ZIP 66111 (Kansas City) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66111 (Kansas City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
71% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
